clk_enable.description: Enable the clock input receiver. The actual control bit is not used. The clock input receiver is always enabled.

clk_en_term.description: Enable input termination for the clock receiver.

test_rx_inv_data.description: Invert the test receiver data polarity.

test_rx_en_term.description: Enable input termination for the test receiver.

test_rx_eq.description: Select the test receiver equalizer setting.

test_rx_common.description: Select the test receiver common-mode setting.

ser_inv_data.description: Invert the serializer driver output data polarity.

ser_drive_str.description: Set the serializer driver output driver strength.

ser_emph_mode.description: Select the serializer driver pre-emphasis mode.

ser_emph_width.description: Set the lower bits of the serializer driver pre-emphasis pulse width.

ser_emph_width_high.description: Set the upper bit of the serializer driver pre-emphasis pulse width.

ser_emph_str.description: Set the serializer driver pre-emphasis strength.

ser_lowSupplyR.description: Set serializer driver low supply resistance.

test_tx_inv_data.description: Invert the test output data polarity.

test_tx_drive_str.description: Set the test output driver strength.

test_tx_emph_mode.description: Select the test output pre-emphasis mode.

test_tx_emph_width.description: Set the lower bits of the test output pre-emphasis pulse width.

test_tx_emph_width_high.description: Set the upper bit of the test output pre-emphasis pulse width.

test_tx_emph_str.description: Set the test output pre-emphasis strength.

test_tx_lowSupplyR.description: Set test out driver low supply resistance.

group_id.description: Set the group identifier used in readout data frame.

reset_readout.description: Write strobe to reset the readout logic.

reset_i2c_readout.description: Write strobe to reset the I2C readout logic.

skip_ck40_strobe.description: Write strobe to change clk40 phase.

tdc_timestamp_num.description: Set the number of TDC timestamps for each measurement.

tdc_encoder.description: Select or enable the TDC encoder mode.

i2c_readout_acq_mode.description: I2C readout acquisition mode. 0: Self-trigger mode. 1: External-trigger mode.

i2c_readout_ext_test.description: External test mode selection. 0: Trigger Mode. 1: Rearm Mode.

test_out_sel.description: 0: clock divider test output. 1: TDC feedback clock signal from channel 5.

channel_mask.description: Mask out individual channels in readout. Active High.

TDC_hit_flag.description: Hit flags for TDC channels 0 through 5. Bit i corresponds to TDC channel i.

self_trig_flag.description: Indicates that data was captured by a self-trigger event.

ext_trig_flag.description: Indicates that data was captured by an external-trigger event.

ch0_TDC_data.description: Byte-addressed TDC data for channel 0. Lowest address contains bits [7:0]; highest address contains bits [63:56].

ch1_TDC_data.description: Byte-addressed TDC data for channel 1. Lowest address contains bits [7:0]; highest address contains bits [63:56].

ch2_TDC_data.description: Byte-addressed TDC data for channel 2. Lowest address contains bits [7:0]; highest address contains bits [63:56].

ch3_TDC_data.description: Byte-addressed TDC data for channel 3. Lowest address contains bits [7:0]; highest address contains bits [63:56].

ch4_TDC_data.description: Byte-addressed TDC data for channel 4. Lowest address contains bits [7:0]; highest address contains bits [63:56].

ch5_TDC_data.description: Byte-addressed TDC data for channel 5. Lowest address contains bits [7:0]; highest address contains bits [63:56].

hit_trig_bcid.description: 9-bit BCID associated with the hit flag. Address 72 bit 0 contains bit 8; address 71 contains bits [7:0].

ext_trig_bcid.description: 9-bit BCID associated with the external trigger. Address 73 bits [1:0] contain bits [8:7]; address 72 bits [7:1] contain bits [6:0].

wb_error_count.description: 8-bit counter for Wishbone Bus not-acknowledge errors.
